payload.title: The mission ledger is not wired to the plan lane on the autonomous path: the planner's answer to a generic queue_item_projected request is acted on by nothing, the mission stays DISCOVERED and is re-selected every cycle, no plan is ever bound to a mission, and promoted findings never become missions
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/autonomy_orchestrator.py:550-582 (the generic projection mints a maintenance_utility planner request and consumes the queue item; nothing else follows)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:4898-4958 (the bridges run after an accepted answer are judge, supporting, plan_convergence and self_change only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_scheduler.py:293-318 (no skip for a mission already asked; a DISCOVERED mission is eligible every cycle)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mission_dispatch.py:88-103 (only the self-change pointer has a contract and only the github_issue pointer has a named consumer)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/promotion_controller.py:195-201 (bind_mission runs only when a mission_id is passed)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cli.py:5544-5557 (the only caller of promote_converged_plan_to_dispatch is the operator CLI)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/task.py:131-140 (finding missions are drawn from list_findings, the tools/findings.jsonl store of active-adapter runs)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_promotion.py:273-294 (a promoted finding is written to aria-findings only)
payload.rule_violated: Mission layer contract (mission_dispatch.py:19-23): a pointer whose answer has no kernel consumer must not ship minted-but-unread; the EveryNextActionHasADispatcher pin covers only the constant pointers, not the free-text next_action of pressure, finding and capability-gap missions.
payload.notes: A pressure, adapter-finding, capability-gap or service-hardening mission is selected each cycle and the drain mints a planner request under the generic must_satisfy 'queue_item_projected'. The accepted answer passes the four bridges, none of which reads it for such a mission, so the mission stays DISCOVERED and the scheduler selects it again next cycle, spending one planner request a cycle on an answer nobody reads. On the autonomous path bind_mission is never called, so a plan carries no ARIA-Mission trailer and the WIP cap, the retry ladder and mission_reconcile have nothing to act on. Promoted consensus findings, which feed plans directly, are not mission candidates at all. Close condition: Make the mission follow its plan: at plan start bind plan_id and move the mission from DISCOVERED to PLANNING, move it to HUMAN_REQUIRED or IMPLEMENTING on the terminal verdict, and delete the generic projection branch for missions with no consumer. Test: a finding mission selected in cycle N has plan_ids bound and state PLANNING at cycle N+1 with no second planner request minted for it (red today), and an invariant over every mission source_kind names the consumer of its accepted answer. Plan row: F3.8 and F3.9 (not started). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
